# awesome-blockchainlab

> Curated list of 225 open-source blockchain projects (+11 extended) forked under Blockchains and kept in sync by fork-sync, with a machine-readable forge.json (fork, upstream, category, licence, stars, docs, starters, index links).

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/awesome-blockchainlab/main/README.md): overview, install and the 'Use as a building block' section
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/awesome-blockchainlab/main/AGENTS.md): setup, build/test commands, structure map, conventions and rules for AI coding agents
- [blocks.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/awesome-blockchainlab/main/blocks.json): machine-readable building-block manifest (entrypoints, inputs, outputs, deps, compatible blocks)

## Key files

- [forge.json](https://github.com/Blockchains/awesome-blockchainlab/blob/main/forge.json): data
- [scripts/validate.py](https://github.com/Blockchains/awesome-blockchainlab/blob/main/scripts/validate.py): validator

## Related

- [Build with Blocks](https://github.com/Blockchains/.github/blob/main/docs/BUILD-WITH-BLOCKS.md): how to assemble projects from Blockchains repos
- [Org llms.txt](https://blockchains.github.io/llms.txt) · [blocks catalogue](https://blockchains.github.io/blocks.json)
- [Blockchains/fork-sync](https://github.com/Blockchains/fork-sync): keeps every listed fork in sync
- [Blockchains/blockchainlab-index](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-index): code index of the same forks (projects[].index links)
- [Blockchains/blockchainlab-starters](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-starters): starters built on these forks
- [Blockchains/blockchainlab-compose](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-compose): composes projects from them
